name: Wakame

low.description: About 2 tablespoons dried or 1/3 cup rehydrated

siboNotes: Sea vegetables are generally well-tolerated and may provide beneficial minerals without triggering SIBO symptoms.
preparationTips: Rinse dried wakame thoroughly before soaking
Soak in cold water for 5-10 minutes until tender
Remove tough center ribs if present
Add to soups in the last few minutes of cooking
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in iodine for thyroid function
Good source of calcium and magnesium
